title: fagus grandifolia subsp. mexicana
intro: Fagus grandifolia subsp. mexicana, commonly known as Mexican American beech, is a subspecies of the American beech tree (Fagus grandifolia) native to eastern North America. This deciduous tree is valued for its wood and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Fagus grandifolia subsp. mexicana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
